The rapper = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY shot: copy the exact face from [Image 1] - face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo, with no beard unless [Image 1] shows one. The same real person in every frame, from the first shot to the last, so their friends instantly recognize them. Never morph, never drift back to the original rapper's face, never add or remove facial hair.

The man in the maroon hoodie who holds the speaker in the foreground keeps his own look and the back of his head; the crowd keeps their own faces.

Anatomy rules: one head per person, on that person's own shoulders. A face never appears on hands, clothes or the speaker. No text, no logos.
